name: raw-source
body: The author's ORIGINAL values exposed to every slide layout and section template under the reserved `.raw` context, alongside the converted field values: `.raw.<field>` is a text field's source Markdown before inline rendering, `.raw.body` the original body source before block rendering; absent when the author supplied nothing. A data value, not a helper; the converted values stay under their own field names. A section invoked by the `section` helper sees `.raw` as the values the call supplied.
